name: Barbara Montauk
source:
A close friend of Ashley's, and a member of the local CoK group, Babs is often overwhelmed by her insecurities—retreating from social interactions. That doesn't stop her from occasionally trying to improve her social skills, despite the anxiety and potential for awkwardness that comes with it.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
